# Energymineral

**Energymineral** is a liquid (pumped continuously) ore. Each extraction yields **100** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/formats/ore-fields/).

## Extraction

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Amount / extraction | 100 |
| Extraction type | liquid (pumped continuously) |
| Enabler effect | not required |
